operations.name: Deprecated package residue
operations.rule: remove only when the directory has 0 files; strip references from package.json

operations.name: Empty bundle directory self-check
operations.rule: directory exists but file count is 0 => treated as not installed; -RepairEmpty attempts reinstall

operations.name: Giant log purge
operations.rule: report files larger than -LogSizeMB whose PID is dead; delete only with -PurgeLogs

operations.name: ReMe memory LLM user environment
operations.target: user environment variables LLM_BACKEND / LLM_MODEL_NAME / LLM_BASE_URL / LLM_API_KEY
operations.rule: report presence without values; write only when explicit values are passed; never store the key in the package or the report

flags.-RepairEmpty: attempt to reinstall empty declared dependencies (pnpm / dsh plugin add)
flags.-PurgeDeprecated: also delete deprecated directories that still contain files (use with care)
flags.-PurgeLogs: actually delete giant logs of dead processes
